releases.description: Includes flagged and unflagged conversations, excluding the sexual/minors category. Contains 122,921 o1-mini/o1-preview conversations.

timeline.event: Start of the collection window reported for the expanded corpus in the May 2024 paper.
The WildChat arXiv version describes the expanded one-million-conversation corpus.
The 4.8M release update extends coverage to before August 1, 2025 and adds secret scanning.

guidance.title: Choose and record a snapshot
guidance.text: Use the yuntian-deng repositories linked here for downloads and access requests. To reproduce an earlier study, match its collection window, revision, and filters.

guidance.title: Request Full access
guidance.text: Submit an access request on yuntian-deng/WildChat-4.8M-Full explaining why your work needs flagged content. Requests are reviewed manually.

guidance.title: Keep evaluation data separate
guidance.text: The processing pipeline removes conversations reserved for WildBench. Preserve that separation when constructing training sets or comparing with the benchmark.

guidance.title: WildChat-50M
guidance.text: WildChat-50M, by Benjamin Feuer and Chinmay Hegde, adds responses from more than 50 open-weight models to WildChat prompts.

guidance.title: Cite WildChat and WildVis
guidance.text: Cite Zhao, Ren, Hessel, Cardie, Choi, and Deng’s ICLR 2024 WildChat paper for the dataset. Cite the WildVis paper when using the visualizer, and identify the downloaded release and revision.

guidance.title: Check terms and removal instructions
guidance.text: The Full release card lists ODC-BY and explains how to request removal using conversation hashes or turn identifiers and the contact details on Yuntian Deng’s homepage.

guidance.title: Geographic metadata
guidance.text: Geographic locations are inferred from IP addresses. Section 6 of the paper describes the service’s user population and sampling biases.

guidance.title: Conversation and turn identifiers
guidance.text: In the expanded releases, conversation_hash is a content hash and can repeat across conversations. turn_identifier uniquely identifies each turn.
